podcast.title: Performance at Gladys Presley's Funeral (1958)
podcast.body: The Blackwood Brothers, a gospel quartet and Gladys Presley's (Elvis's mother) favorite musical group, were asked by Elvis to sing "Precious Memories" at her funeral on August 14, 1958. "At the funeral, Elvis got the Blackwood Brothers, Gladys' favourite gospel quartet, to sing precious memories."
